channel.title: Pratik Dhanave — Blog
channel.description: Long-form writing on multi-agent AI, medical AI governance, HIPAA-aware architecture, and cloud-native systems.

item.title: Order Types and Time-in-Force as a Lifecycle
item.description: Model order-type and time-in-force semantics (limit/market/stop; GTC/IOC/FOK) as a lifecycle.

item.title: Reconstructing an Order Book from a Market-Data Feed
item.description: Handle a market-data feed: sequence checking, gap recovery, and snapshot-plus-delta order-book reconstruction.

item.title: Pre-Trade Risk, Positions, and Real-Time P&L
item.description: Enforce pre-trade risk limits and keep real-time positions and mark-to-market P&L.

item.title: Engineering SCA Exemptions Without Wrecking Conversion
item.description: Decide PSD2 SCA exemptions (low-value, TRA, allowlist) to keep low-risk payments frictionless around 3DS.

item.title: Engineering DORA Operational Resilience
item.description: Engineer DORA operational resilience: ICT asset/third-party risk, incident classification, reporting, and resilience testing.

item.title: Building a FATCA/CRS Tax Reporting Pipeline
item.description: Classify account tax residency and generate withholding and FATCA/CRS reporting files.

item.title: Designing an Identity Verification Pipeline
item.description: Build a document + liveness/biometric identity-verification pipeline that returns a graded decision.

item.title: From AML Alert to Filed SAR: Engineering the Case Management Pipeline
item.description: Turn AML alerts into investigated cases and filed SAR/STR reports, complementing rule-based monitoring.

item.title: Engineering a Pay-in-4 BNPL Flow
item.description: Engineer a 4-installment BNPL flow: checkout-time soft credit check, upfront merchant settlement, and installment collection.

item.title: Engineering a Loan Origination Pipeline
item.description: Design a loan origination pipeline from application through underwriting, offer, and disbursal.

item.title: Collateral and LTV Management: Engineering the Loop That Watches Value Slip
item.description: Track collateral valuation, loan-to-value, margin calls, and liquidation triggers.

item.title: Variable Recurring Payments and Metered Billing as a Mandate Lifecycle
item.description: Model variable recurring payments and metered/subscription billing with proration, distinct from retry logic.

item.title: Building the Issuer Side of a Card Program
item.description: Build the issuer side: BIN/program config, card production, PIN generation via HSM, and real-time authorization controls.

item.title: The Card Payment Actors Map: Who Actually Does What
item.description: One reference map of who does what in a card payment: cardholder, merchant, gateway, acquirer/processor, scheme, issuer, and the settlement return path.

item.title: Payment Orchestration: Routing One Charge Across Many PSPs
item.description: Route a payment across multiple PSPs to maximize auth rate, with health-aware routing, failover, and normalized webhooks.

item.title: Confirmation of Payee: Checking the Name Before the Money Leaves
item.description: Name-match the beneficiary before a push payment to stop authorized-push-payment (APP) fraud.

item.title: Engineering EMVCo QR Payments
item.description: Encode and decode EMVCo QR payloads (static vs dynamic), handle expiry, and reconcile QR-initiated payments.

item.title: Three-Way Reconciliation That Closes the Long Tail
item.description: Teaches how to build a three-way reconciliation engine (internal ledger vs processor vs bank statement): matching keys and tolerances, break classification, aging, and auto-resolution rules for the long tail.

item.title: Key Ceremonies and HSM Key Hierarchies for Payments
item.description: Teaches how to run cryptographic key management for payments: HSM-backed key hierarchies (LMK/ZMK/ZPK), key ceremonies with split knowledge and dual control, rotation, and PIN-block translation.

item.title: Interbank mTLS and Message Signing
item.description: Teaches how to secure bank-to-bank and scheme connectivity: mutual TLS with certificate pinning/rotation, detached JWS/XML message signing for non-repudiation, and replay protection with nonces and timestamps.

item.title: Moving Money Across Services Without a Distributed Transaction
item.description: Teaches how to coordinate a multi-step payment across services without distributed transactions: orchestrated saga steps, compensating actions for partial failures, and guaranteeing money is never stranded.

item.title: Crediting Crypto Deposits Without Getting Burned by Reorgs
item.description: Teaches how to safely credit crypto deposits and finalize settlement: confirmation-depth thresholds, mempool/pending tracking, chain-reorg detection and balance rollback, and idempotent handling of replaced transactions.

item.title: Engineering a Fiat-Backed Stablecoin: Mint, Burn, and the Reserve Invariant
item.description: Teaches how to engineer a fiat-backed stablecoin: mint-on-deposit / burn-on-redeem flows tied to a reserve ledger, 1:1 reserve invariant checks, and reconciliation between on-chain supply and off-chain custody balances.

item.title: Engineering Treasury Liquidity: Automated Cash Sweeps
item.description: Teaches how to engineer treasury liquidity: multi-account balance aggregation, target-balance and zero-balance sweep rules, cutoff-aware transfers, and intraday funding checks to keep settlement accounts solvent.

item.title: Designing a Deterministic Order-Book Matching Engine
item.description: Teaches how to build a deterministic matching engine: price-time priority order book, limit/market/IOC/FOK order types, single-threaded sequencer for determinism, and gap-free trade/execution event streaming.

item.title: Building Custody: Hot, Warm, and Cold Wallets Without a Single Point of Compromise
item.description: Teaches how to architect custody: hot/warm/cold wallet tiers, HSM or MPC key custody, withdrawal approval quorum, address derivation (HD wallets), and sweep flows from deposit to cold storage.

item.title: Rules and ML in One Fraud Decision Path
item.description: Teaches how to combine a deterministic rules engine with an ML risk model in one decision path: rule-precedence and overrides, model score bands, shadow mode, and champion/challenger evaluation with feedback labels.

item.title: Building a Step-Up Authentication Orchestrator
item.description: Teaches how to build risk-based step-up auth: an orchestration layer that escalates from silent to OTP/biometric/3DS challenge based on risk signals, with pending-challenge state and resumable transaction context.

item.title: Building an FX Rate, Spread & Markup Engine
item.description: Teaches how to build an FX pricing service: ingesting multiple rate feeds, mid-rate derivation, staleness/circuit-breaker handling, per-segment spread/markup, and rate-lock quotes with expiry for customer conversions.

item.title: Engineering the Open Banking Consent Layer: SCA, Scopes, and Token Lifecycles
item.description: Teaches how to build open-banking APIs: strong customer authentication and exemptions, consent grant/lifecycle, account-information vs payment-initiation scopes, and TPP authorization with token/consent revocation.

item.title: Engineering a Basel RWA Calculation Engine
item.description: Teaches the engineering of a risk-weighted-asset calculator: exposure classification, risk-weight lookup (standardized approach), credit-conversion factors for off-balance items, and capital-ratio aggregation for regulatory reporting.

item.title: Real-Time Velocity Checks and the Fraud Feature Store
item.description: Teaches how to build low-latency velocity checks: sliding-window counters and aggregates in an online feature store, entity keys (card/device/IP), and consistency between real-time and batch-computed features.

item.title: Building an AML Transaction Monitoring Rules Engine
item.description: Teaches how to build AML transaction monitoring: typology rules (structuring, rapid movement, layering), sliding-window aggregation, alert scoring and deduplication, and case management feeding STR/SAR filing.

item.title: Implementing the FATF Travel Rule Between VASPs
item.description: Teaches how to implement the FATF Travel Rule between VASPs: originator/beneficiary PII exchange protocols (IVMS101, TRP/OpenVASP), counterparty VASP discovery, and pre-transfer verification before on-chain send.

item.title: Resolving Ultimate Beneficial Ownership as a Graph Problem
item.description: Teaches how to compute ultimate beneficial ownership: modeling ownership as a graph, percentage-through-chain calculation, control vs ownership thresholds, and cycle handling to surface >25% beneficial owners.

item.title: Delinquency as a State Machine: DPD Buckets, SMA, and NPA Classification
item.description: Teaches how to model delinquency as a state machine: days-past-due bucket transitions, SMA/NPA classification rules, provisioning triggers, and cure/roll-forward/roll-back logic driven by repayment events.

item.title: Building a Credit Decisioning Engine
item.description: Teaches how to build a decisioning engine: feature assembly from bureau/bank/alt data, scorecard vs ML model serving, policy rules and cutoffs, and adverse-action reason-code generation with an audit trail.

item.title: Building a Sanctions Screening Engine That Controls False Positives
item.description: Teaches how to build sanctions/watchlist screening: list ingestion (OFAC/UN/EU), transliteration and fuzzy name matching, scoring thresholds, whitelisting, and rescreening on list deltas to control false positives.

item.title: Building a Dunning and Retry Engine for Failed Payments
item.description: Teaches how to build a smart retry/dunning system: decline-code classification (hard vs soft), backoff and retry-window scheduling, retry-budget limits, and network-token refresh to recover subscription revenue.

item.title: Building a Deterministic Amortization Schedule Engine
item.description: Teaches how to compute loan amortization deterministically: EMI/annuity vs reducing-balance formulas, day-count conventions, principal/interest split per installment, and prepayment/rescheduling recalculation.

item.title: Building a Daily Interest Accrual Engine
item.description: Teaches how to build a daily interest accrual engine: accrual basis and compounding, accrued-but-unbilled tracking, rate changes mid-period, and idempotent daily accrual jobs that post to the ledger.

item.title: Building Marketplace Split Payments and Connected Payouts
item.description: Teaches how to architect marketplace money movement: platform vs connected-account balances, fee/commission splits, delayed payouts, negative-balance handling, and merchant-of-record vs facilitator models.

item.title: Building a Revenue Recognition Engine
item.description: Teaches how to build a rev-rec engine: performance obligations, deferred-vs-recognized schedules, ratable recognition over time, and how billing events differ from recognition events in the ledger.

item.title: Engineering Escrow: Conditional Hold and Release with Double-Entry Safety
item.description: Teaches how to build escrow and conditional hold/release: segregated escrow ledger accounts, release conditions/approvals, partial releases, and expiry auto-refund with double-entry safety.

item.title: Chart of Accounts and Sub-Ledger Modeling
item.description: Teaches how to design a chart of accounts and sub-ledger-to-GL posting model: account hierarchy, dimensions/segments, contra accounts, and how product events map to balanced journal entries.

item.title: Multi-Currency Accounting and FX Revaluation
item.description: Teaches how to keep books in multiple currencies with a functional/reporting currency: transaction-date vs settlement-date rates, unrealized/realized FX gain-loss postings, and period-end revaluation runs.

item.title: Automating the Financial Close
item.description: Teaches how to automate the financial close: ledger cutoff/freeze, accrual and reversing entries, trial-balance assembly, out-of-balance detection, and soft-close vs hard-close controls.

item.title: RTGS vs Deferred Net Settlement
item.description: Teaches the engineering tradeoffs between gross real-time settlement and deferred net settlement: liquidity vs finality, queue/gridlock resolution in RTGS, and settlement-risk windows in DNS.

item.title: Nostro/Vostro Reconciliation, From the Ledger Up
item.description: Teaches how to reconcile correspondent-bank nostro/vostro balances: mirror-account bookkeeping, expected-vs-actual statement (camt.053) matching, value-date breaks, and unreconciled-item aging.

item.title: Payment-versus-Payment: Settling FX Without Principal Risk
item.description: Teaches how payment-versus-payment settlement eliminates Herstatt (principal) risk in FX: matched trade submission, pay-in schedules, simultaneous conditional settlement, and pay-out with net funding.
